name: Kaioken Research
summary: Kaioken Research is a research pipeline that gathers web sources, extracts clean text excerpts, and uses an LLM to produce a JSON research answer with numbered citations, which is then verified for citation defects and stored as a markdown artifact. It distinguishes grounded facts (cited) from synthesis (uncited), defends against prompt injection and SSRF via URL/private-IP checks, and supports depth/breadth tuning per run. Artifacts are written to $KAIOKEN_DIR/research and inherit system provenance, keeping the agent loop auditable and replayable.
keyPoints: Pipeline stages: ports.ts defines WebSearchPort/WebFetchPort and SSRF guards (normaliseUrl, isPrivateIp, isFetchableUrlResolved); run.ts implements gatherSources (concurrent web gathering) and generateResearch (LLM prompt, JSON parse, pathFor); verify.ts verifies citations against sources/excerpts; artifact.ts persists documents and parses markdown back.

LLM contract: run.ts SYSTEM and REPAIR_SYSTEM prompt the model to reply JSON-only {"title","body"} with [N] citations to exact source numbers; REPAIR_SYSTEM fixes only the defects named in a verification report, nothing else.
Safety: sanitize.ts strips script/style/svg, respects BLOCK_TAGS for text extraction, detects injectionPatterns; ports.ts blocks localhost, .local, .internal, private IPs to prevent SSRF.

Provenance and audit: artifact.ts writes documents under RESEARCH_DIR and asProvenance records each artifact, so every research output traces to its sources and runs; verification defects (unknown_source, quote_not_found, uncited_claim, cites_failed_fetch) drive the repair step.

Depth control: types.ts defines ResearchDepth with MIN/MAX_MULTIPLIER (1–10) and BREADTH_THRESHOLD=5; depthFor maps a multiplier to a depth, controlling how many sources/citations are requested per question.

entryPoints.name: gatherSources
entryPoints.note: Collects web sources for a question via ports (search+fetch) with concurrency, dedupe, and excerpt extraction; returns GatherResult.

entryPoints.name: generateResearch
entryPoints.note: Calls the model with buildPrompt (question, excerpts, depth), parses the JSON reply, and produces GenerateResult.

entryPoints.name: verifyCitations
entryPoints.note: Checks body citations against sources/excerpts; returns ResearchVerification of grounded citations and defects.

entryPoints.name: writeResearchDocument
entryPoints.note: Persists a verified document as markdown under the research dir, returning the file path.

entryPoints.name: parseArtifact
entryPoints.note: Parses markdown back into a ResearchDocument for later reading/auditing.
